Pinboard.description: Windows app that pins macOS-style widgets to the desktop: clocks, calendar, countdown, system stats, photo frame and now playing. Updates itself from GitHub releases.

ExamsTrack.description: Plan exams and study tasks, track the grade average and estimate the graduation mark, with widgets, Live Activities and sync across iPhone, iPad and PC.

Expenses.description: Track monthly spending by tag, with budgets and alerts, recurring expenses, Home and Lock Screen widgets and Wallet automation.

DashPrise.description: Role-based operations dashboard with a live facility map, leave calendar, 3D device view and admin and HR tools, in English and Italian.

PaperSieve.description: Search arXiv across categories, filter by keyword, author or category, save favorites and export BibTeX. Built to WCAG 2.1 AA.
